neighbours.label: the step boundary (' and', '.', ',') that ends an action in cooking recipe instructions ('pour into the pan and smooth the top')
fire: Spoon the dough onto the baking sheet and flatten each ball slightly.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar until pale, then fold in the flour.
Scrape the batter into the greased tin and level it with a knife.
Melt the butter in a saucepan. Stir in the cocoa and remove from the heat.
Toss the chopped apples with cinnamon and arrange them over the crust.
Blend the soaked dates until smooth, and press the mixture into the tray.
Sift the flour into a bowl. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips.
Pour the custard over the sliced bananas and chill for two hours.
quiet: Slide the drawer into the cabinet frame and tighten each screw slightly.
Sand the board with fine paper until smooth, then wipe off the dust.
Fit the new filter into the housing and seal it with the clamp.
Unplug the router from the wall. Wait ten seconds and plug it back in.
Thread the cable through the bracket and fix it to the wall.
Tape the edges of the window, and paint the frame with a small brush.
Loosen the wheel nuts. Lift the car with the jack and remove the wheel.
Pour the oil into the engine and check the level after two minutes.
